Name: Soup du Jour
Author: ch0opera
Description:
[center][font=Arial][size=3][url=http://]﻿[/url]﻿
Do you enjoy cooking in Stardew Valley and fancy learning new recipes?
Do you also love soup?

Then this is the mod for you! [/size]

𝄖𝄖𝄖 𝄖 𝄖 𝄖 𝄖 𝄖 𝄖𝄖𝄖

🥄 ❤ SOUP

It's a wonderful, versatile food. 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/BdGUPI0.png[/img]﻿
[b][color=#d8d8d8][size=5]🅢🅞🅤🅟   🅓🅤    🅙🅞🅤🅡[/size][/color]

[color=#b4a7d6][size=3]WHAT THIS MOD ADDS[/size][size=3] [/size][/color][/b]
[size=3]This mod will add many soups of all kinds & their respective recipes.

✤ Version [b][color=#9fc5e8]1.0.1 [/color][/b]contains the first ten (10) soups in the list below. 
✤ Plus three (3) new crops and one (1) artisanal sausage.[/size]

[color=#b4a7d6][size=3][b]LIST OF SOUPS[/b] ([i]WIP[/i])[/size][/color]
[spoiler]
[color=#9fc5e8][size=4]❶⸳⓿⸳❶[/size][/color]
[color=#b4a7d6]- Artsy Soup
- Avgolemono Soup
- Blueberry Lavender Soup
- Borscht
- Bouillabaisse
- Bourride 
- Caldo Verde
- Chilled Strawberry Lavender Soup
- Egg Drop Soup
- Summer Melon Gazpacho[/color]

[color=#666666][i]~[size=3][b]coming soon[/b][/size]~[/i]
- Italian Wedding Soup
- Laksa
- Maafe (African Peanut Stew)
- Manhattan Clam Chowdah
- Minestrone 
- New England Clam Chowdah 
- Pho
- Ribollita
- Sancocho
- Sinigang 
- Split Pea Soup
- Soupy Soup (Chana Dal)
- Stone Soup
- Tortilla Soup 
- Vichyssoise 
- Wonton Soup[/color]
[/spoiler]
[size=3]
🥣 Eventually, the Soup du Jour soups will be served at the art gallery cafe for SMoMA (the big art market project I've been working on – coming Soon™).
[/size]
[line][b][color=#b4a7d6]
[size=3]WHERE TO OBTAIN NEW RECIPES [/size][/color][/b][size=3]
Most recipes are purchasable from Gus at the Stardrop Saloon.
Some recipes are sent via mail when certain requirements are met. 

[b][color=#d9d2e9]ARTICLES[/color][/b]
For a working list of soup recipes please see the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/1447]Recipes[/url]﻿ article.
Please refer to this guide to view the recipe [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/1451]Unlock Conditions[/url]﻿.
[/size]
[line][size=3]
[b][color=#b4a7d6]REQUIREMENTS[/color][/b]
This mod uses many ingredients not available in vanilla, hence the handful of dependencies.
However, some requirements may be flexible**. Please read the clarification below.[/size]

[spoiler]
□ [b]JSON Assets[/b] – absolute requirement.
□ [b]Mail Framework Mod [/b]– absolute requirement.
[color=#b4a7d6][size=3][b]
~ [i]as of version 1.0.0 ~[/i][/b][/size][/color]
□[color=#8e7cc3] [b][PPJA] Artisan Valley[/b][/color] – for garlic mayonnaise, sesame oil, saffron
□ [b][color=#8e7cc3][PPJA] Fruits & Veggies[/color][/b] – for carrot, cucumber, mint, onion, parsley, shallot
□ [color=#8e7cc3][b][PPJA] Mizu's Flowers[/b] [/color]– for herbal lavender 
□ [color=#8e7cc3][b][PPJA] More Trees[/b] [/color]– for lemon, lime
□ [color=#8e7cc3][b][PPJA] Fresh Meat[/b] [/color]-&/OR- [color=#8e7cc3][b]Animal Husbandry Mod[/b] [/color]– for various meat products used in certain soups ([b][i]both[/i] mods = A-OK ✔[/b])

 [/font][b][i]Note[/i][/b]: FM provides objects/recipes for both raw and cooked types of meat. The recipe for "Choriço" (added by this mod) calls for "Cooked Pork". You can change it to simply "Pork" if using AHM without FM. I personally play with both FM & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]AHM[/url]﻿.

□ [b][color=#8e7cc3][PPJA] Even More Recipes[/color][/b] – for various soup stocks, sesame seeds
□ [b][color=#8e7cc3][PPJA] More Recipes[/color][/b] – for paprika 
□ [b][color=#8e7cc3]Ssaturn's Tropical Kitchen[/color][/b] – for coconut cream, turmeric

[b][i] Note[/i][/b]: I believe [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8256]Raffadax[/url]﻿ also adds many of the same objects found in the various PPJA packs so it may also be compatible as an alternative. (I play with both PPJA and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13518]Raffadax Light[/url]﻿ and the duplicate objects from the latter are disabled so I can't guarantee 100% compatibility.)
[b]Tl;dr[/b]: Raffadax _[i]might[/i]_ work in lieu of some of the listed requirements if you prefer to use that mod.

[size=3][color=#d9d2e9]⁂[/color]
[color=#d9d2e9]**I do strongly encourage the use of all requirements as that's how this mod was designed.
Some recipes will not be available without the required mods.[/color][/size][font=Arial]
[line]
[b]🧁  [color=#d9d2e9]RECOMMENDED[/color]  🍨[/b]
□ [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/541]Lookup Anything[/url]﻿[/b] – highly recommended for easier access to recipe & ingredients info.
[/spoiler]


[size=3][b][color=#d9d2e9]🍞  [/color][color=#b4a7d6]COMPATIBILITY[/color][color=#d9d2e9]  [b][color=#d9d2e9]🧈[/color][/b][/color][/b]
This mod should be compatible with all mods.
It was designed with many various cooking/recipe mods in mind to avoid overlaps or conflicts.
Please do feel free to report any issues that might've been missed! ♡
